_doc: Wallpaper slideshow. Pictures live in local-assets/wallpapers (bundled into the APK) or are pushed to the TV folder; this file says how to show them. Per-picture keys override 'default'. effect: spores | fireflies | ash | embers | rain | dust | fog | none. Options per effect: count, speed, size, color (hex), opacity, angle (rain), beam [x1,y1,x2,y2,width] (dust). shade: 0-1 strength of the readability gradients. See docs/STANDALONE.md.
